FULL TEXT:
SSB University Institute of Chemical Engineering and Technology,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
ADVERTISEMENT FOR JRF UNDER DST SPONSORED PROJECT
Applications are invited for the appointment of JRF under DST-TDP sponsored project entitled
“Ecofriendly Low-Cost Composite Panels for Indoor Applications Based on Biomass Residue
(Rice Straw/Rice Husk) and Vegetal Polyurethane Binder (BIOPUCOM)” on a purely
temporary (co-terminus with the project) basis for the candidates fulfilling the following eligibility
criteria:
Essential Qualifications
1. M.E./ M. Tech in Chemical/ Environmental/ Material Science/ Mechanical OR M.Sc.
degree in Chemistry with at least 55% marks
2. Qualified NET-JRF, GATE, or any other national fellowship
Preferred:
1. Preference will be given to a candidate who is planning to pursue a Ph.D. with the
fellowship
Salary & Benefits: Rs. 37,000/- + HRA (as per applicable rules).
Age Limit: Below 30 years as of the last date of application.
How to apply:
Interested candidates may email their applications with detailed biodata (including contact number
and email address) and copies of mark sheets and relevant certificates to anupamasharma@pu.ac.in
by 20th September 2025.
Note: The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email along with the interview date.
Dr. Anupama Sharma,
Chairperson,
SSB University Institute of Chemical Engineering and Technology,
Director, Energy Research Centre
Panjab University, Chandigarh
